attributes.name: logo_treatment
attributes.definition: How the logo/brand mark is composed in the header or brand area (text-only, icon plus text, image, etc.).

values.definition: Logo is purely typographic text, possibly with a small accent (e.g. dot), no image or icon.
An emblem/icon/image paired with a text wordmark or name.
Logo shown as an image without accompanying text wordmark.

attributes.name: logo_emblem_container
attributes.definition: Whether the logo emblem/icon sits on a distinct background shape or is shown bare.

values.definition: Emblem placed on a solid colored square/shape.
Emblem/icon shown directly with no container.

attributes.name: wordmark_color_treatment
attributes.definition: How the wordmark text is colored.

values.definition: Wordmark in one color (e.g. bold dark text).
Wordmark uses a contrasting accent word or accent element in a second color.

attributes.name: secondary_logo_placement
attributes.definition: Treatment of logos outside the main header, such as footer or sponsor logos: size and alignment.

values.definition: Smaller logo aligned to the left.
